Feature reference and adapted behavior:
https://github.com/YOURSJEYO/claude-switcher
Original integration revision: b74112a508762bd33c1400fb17c922c72ab26604
macOS update reference: 303cd1057cc1ab2f24cfac5b4c0a43094011caa1
Adapted macOS commits:
2cf108596a7bb382acbc62c2d1dd9b89e17e1d71 (read-only explicit proxy diagnostics)
c8a1069955b074b0b068cc48a7c32b779ff643ce (move archives and copy-on-write loading)

The 14-check inventory, A/B profile workflow, proxy modes, region mapping,
13-domain pinned rule list, native STUN probe and scheduled protection/update
features are adapted into Claude Watch's own runtime and interface.

Since 2.9.1, the pinned original account functions (status, archive_current,
copy_tree and switch_to) execute directly in a private verified workspace.
The upstream quit/open hooks are bound to the host process checks and complete
launch gate. The host publishes the original engine outputs with schema-3
recovery; schema-1 and schema-2 recovery remain supported.
Process identity checks, audit results, preview-bound repairs and release
updates remain local integration code.
An empty STUN result is not treated as a pass. The integrated interface keeps
all fourteen checks and displays their evidence boundaries.

Proxy diagnostics use an independent transport-only command and GUI result;
they do not grant launch permission or modify account/environment policy.
Snapshot optimization retains full source/destination hashes, private storage,
version/launch gates, and recoverable journals. Same-volume archive moves use
a schema-2 account journal; schema-1 recovery remains supported. APFS file
clones fall back to verified regular copying on unsupported filesystems.
Separate Web, Windows and Linux additions are outside this macOS adaptation.

Version 2.6 adds direct current-environment detection without saved-target or
enabled-policy prerequisites. Measurements and their sources are displayed;
this receipt cannot grant launch permission. Optional environment adjustments
use an expiring, context-bound plan and a separate recovery journal. Existing
account hashes, launch checks and complete-release rollback remain.

The upstream MIT notice is retained in LICENSE. This integration is not an
endorsement by the upstream project, Anthropic or any proxy vendor.

Directly vendored macOS source revision:
e2da42956bccd39f5e8e2e052c5002b96137f146
See UPSTREAM.json for file-by-file original Git blob IDs and SHA-256 hashes.
The upstream files in upstream/ are unmodified. The top-level shell setup,
installer and daemons are retained for provenance, not automatically executed.
Runtime DNS renewal uses the existing collector at launch gates; it does not
extend evidence expiry or bypass risk checks.
